    DEFAULT_ELEMENT_IMAGE_PATH - Static variable in class model.Element
    The default image path is set to "NONE"
    DEFAULT_ELEMENT_NAME - Static variable in class model.Element
    The default name is set to "element"
    DEFAULT_TIER_COLOR - Static variable in class model.Tier
    The default color is set to Color.gray
    DEFAULT_TIER_NAME - Static variable in class model.Tier
    The default name is set to String "New Tier"
    DEFAULT_TIERLIST_NAME - Static variable in class model.TierList
    The default name is set to String "New Tierlist"
